$comment: Coverage ratchet — single source of truth. Read by vitest.config.ts (which
enforces `floors` as hard vitest thresholds) and by scripts/check-coverage-ratchet.mjs
(which additionally fails when actual coverage has climbed more than `slack`
points above a floor, forcing the floor to be ratcheted up).
Never lower a floor to make a red build green — add tests instead. Raising a
floor is the normal, expected edit: the ratchet gate prints the exact numbers.
headroomPoints = how far below actual a freshly ratcheted floor sits. Small
buffer so an unrelated refactor that shaves a covered line does not red the build.
target = informational only, never fails a build.
2026-08-19: the defineTool migration deleted 105 one-line `export function
registerX(...)` wrappers (all covered) and columnsOf() deleted ~83 one-line
column getters (mostly uncovered). Both changed the DENOMINATOR without
changing which code is exercised — functions dipped 60 -> 57 on the first,
then climbed to 63 on the second, which is why the floor lands at 61.
